summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). No values retrieved; every empirical item is pending. Designed (1) a seven-province welfare dashboard with rows tagged to the 12 objectives in welfare.py, kept separate from GDP and without composite province ranking; (2) a gender-gap table in three blocks (participation from NLFS 2017/18 pending NLFS 2024/25; wages from NLFS earnings and ILOSTAT SDG 8.5.1; assets from NDHS 2022, NPHC 2021 and NSCA 2021/22); (3) a caste/ethnic group gap table restricted to NPHC 2021 official codes or the grouping as published in each source, reporting only documented gaps. Provincial HDI depends on Nepal HDR 2020 (reference year predates NPHC 2021) and NNRFC inputs; provincial poverty reuses 14A's NLSS IV observation set. One WebSearch located the NSO Nepal Atlas of Caste and Ethnic Groups and indicated an NPHC 2021 Caste/Ethnicity report on the census portal.

findings.claim: Method: provincial dispersion for the poverty_inclusion objective is measured as the population-weighted coefficient of variation and the max-min range of provincial national-line headcounts from the same NLSS round; changes between rounds are reported only on a comparable line.
findings.note: Design choice (14B-A2); to be confirmed with Agent 15.

findings.claim: Method: group gap tables use only NSO/NPHC 2021 caste/ethnicity codes or the aggregated grouping exactly as published by the source table; no re-grouping, ranking or characterisation of groups; gaps are reported as differences to the national average with SEs where survey-based.

data_gaps: No current labour force survey report: NLFS 2017/18 is the latest; NLFS 2024/25 report not located, so gender participation and wage gaps are dated.
Provincial HDI: latest known official-partner source is Nepal HDR 2020 (URL unverified); no post-NPHC 2021 provincial HDI located.
Provincial GDP release and consistent provincial population denominators (10C) not yet retrieved.
Caste/ethnic group welfare outcomes (poverty, consumption) require NLSS IV group tables or microdata; small groups may be too imprecise to report.
Adjusted gender pay gap requires NLFS microdata.
No official provincial series for safeguard/grievance (rights_accountability) or provincial exports identified.
Provincial MPI report (NPC) URL and reference year not verified.

assumptions.text: Group gap tables use only official classifications (NPHC 2021 codes or the grouping as published in each source table), with verbatim labels; no characterisation or ranking of groups.
assumptions.basis_note: original label: 'assumption (task rule and platform non-negotiables)'

assumptions.text: Provincial dispersion indicator for poverty_inclusion = population-weighted CV and max-min range of national-line headcounts within one NLSS round.
NDHS 2022 is treated as an official MoHP survey for gender/asset indicators although the catalog lists dhs at tier 7.
assumptions.basis_note: original label: 'assumption; flag for 00B source-tier review'

assumptions.text: Seven provinces use current official names; historical development-region series are not mapped to provinces without a documented district-level crosswalk.

challenges.text: Source tier: catalog places dhs at tier 7 although NDHS is implemented under MoHP; request tier review. Register watch items: women's house/land ownership NDHS 2022 (individual) vs NPHC 2021 (household) - definitional, not a conflict; provincial HDI Nepal HDR 2020 vs NNRFC formula inputs - vintage/method.
Please expose provincial and caste/ethnic breakdowns in the NLSS IV observation set so 14B reuses the same observations (no second extraction).
Gender participation and wage gaps depend on 10B's NLFS 2017/18 ingestion; please include sex x province tables and earnings by sex, and flag when NLFS 2024/25 report is located.
Need provincial resident-population denominators by sex (NPHC 2021 base and NSO projection) for per-capita provincial indicators.
Findex gender account-ownership items are shared; 14B will cite 03B's observations rather than re-ingesting.
Distributional conclusions for all strategies remain unverified until provincial and group gaps are populated; do not treat any strategy as inclusion-neutral in r1.

uncertainty: Total for r1: no values retrieved. Main uncertainties for r2: (1) gender labour gaps rest on NLFS 2017/18 and may be materially outdated given migration since then; (2) provincial HDI source vintage predates the census and provincial GDP revisions; (3) group-level survey estimates may have wide SEs for small groups and group definitions differ across NPHC, NLSS and NDHS, so cross-source comparisons need crosswalks; (4) several URLs are from general knowledge and unverified (marked in leads); (5) NLSS IV data-quality critique noted by 14A applies to provincial and group breakdowns.

provincial_dashboard.design: Seven provinces (Constitution of Nepal schedule; current names) as columns plus national; each row an indicator tagged to one of the 12 objectives in src/economic_model/welfare.py OBJECTIVES. Each cell will hold an observation id, value, unit, period (FY vs calendar stated) and SE where survey-based. Provincial dispersion (CV and max-min) computed per row. Dashboard is separate from GDP; provincial GDP per capita is one row under 'growth', not a summary score. No composite ranking of provinces.

provincial_dashboard.method: Ingest NSO tables as primary (tier 1); UNDP/NPC HDR as tier 3; NDHS tier 7 per catalog but used as the official MoHP survey. Compute dispersion only across the same survey round and definition. Record FY vs calendar year per row.

gender_gap_table.design: Rows = indicator; columns = female, male, gap (female minus male in percentage points, or female/male ratio for earnings), national and by province and urban/rural; each cell cites an observation id and SE. Three blocks: participation, wages, assets.

participation.indicator: unpaid domestic and care work time share (SDG 5.4.1)
female share of absent population abroad

wages.indicator: female/male mean monthly earnings of employees (unadjusted)
gender pay gap, average hourly earnings (SDG 8.5.1)
adjusted gender pay gap (Oaxaca-Blinder: education, age, occupation, industry, province)
wages.note: Estimate once microdata ingested; labelled estimate with method.

assets.indicator: women owning land (alone/jointly); with title in own name
households with female ownership of house and/or land
assets.note: Household concept differs from NDHS individual concept; keep both.

assets.indicator: agricultural holdings with female holder; share of area operated

composite_references.indicator: GDI, GII (national; provincial from Nepal HDR 2020)

group_gap_table.classification_rule: Use the NPHC 2021 caste/ethnicity code list exactly as published by NSO, or the aggregated grouping exactly as it appears in the source table (NLSS IV, NDHS 2022, Nepal HDR), recording the source's own labels and group definitions verbatim. No re-grouping across sources without a documented crosswalk; no ranking or characterisation of groups; only differences documented in official tables (or computed from official microdata with SEs) are reported. Constitutional inclusion categories (Constitution of Nepal, lead 14B-L25) are recorded as legal categories only.

official_classifications.note: Number of groups and codes to be taken from the NSO report on retrieval.

indicators.indicator: population share by group and province
literacy rate by group and sex
under-5 stunting and women's asset ownership by grouping
household amenities (electricity, piped water, internet) by group

group_gap_table.gap_metric: Difference from national average (percentage_points) and ratio to national average; survey-based cells with design-based SEs; cells below a precision threshold suppressed and flagged.
